description: Truncating the tail of a chain leaves it internally valid.
note: THE MOST IMPORTANT VECTOR IN THIS FAMILY, and the only one that asserts a WEAKNESS rather than a guarantee. Any prefix of a valid chain is itself valid, so an agent that was refused can delete the refusal and verification reports success about a history that did not happen. An implementation whose verify() FAILED here would be claiming something a bare hash chain cannot deliver -- so passing this vector is required, and disclosing the gap is what EVID-6 asks for instead.
